''See also: [[Remnant Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Remnants]] are living forces composed of [[pure madra]] that emerge from the corpses of powerful [[sacred artists]] or certain [[sacred beasts]] upon their death. They often appear as colorful, sketch-like outlines or skeletal structures that mimic the shape of their former physical bodies, such as trees, animals, or humans. While they lack true physical substance and can pass through barriers, they possess varying degrees of intelligence, reasoning, and memory. Most [[Remnants]] are limited to fragments of their past lives, though some can develop independent awareness or unique personalities over time. Their behavior is often unpredictable; they may act with fury, follow specific obsessions, or display disorientation immediately after birth. [[Remnants]] serve various roles in the world. Some act as dangerous wild entities, while others are utilized by [[Soulsmiths]], who can harvest their parts—such as bindings or specific limbs—to create tools, weapons, or assistants known as drudges. They can also be absorbed by others to provide [[madra]] and memories, or even integrated into a person's body as specialized limbs. While many are mere echoes of the deceased, certain high-level [[Remnants]], such as those from [[Heralds]] or [[Monarchs]], are exceptionally robust, possess powerful wills, and can even be sealed for long periods.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Remnants]] are substances or items that [[Soulsmiths]] can mold, consisting of [[pure madra]] constructions freed from their physical bodies. These entities are formed when a powerful [[sacred artist]] dies, leaving behind their soul as a living force that hungers for human [[madra]] and can develop consciousness. While they possess only narrow fragments of their former memories, these shadow-like beings can advance in power over time. A Remnant's form varies, ranging from a purple, skeletal tree to an ogre-like outline made of [[Mountain's Heart]] power. In combat, a [[sword]]-aspect Remnant provides great strength despite being weak in pursuit, and consuming one can provide the critical [[advancement]] from [[Jade]] to [[Gold]]. Some highly potent [[Remnants]], such as a [[Forged madra]] entity from an expert beyond [[Gold]], have even been known to break through ancient seals and leak silvery motes of essence during battle.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Remnants]] are creatures or objects found within the Wilds that tend to gather in areas where [[vital aura]] is thick. These entities, which can emerge from walls or peel themselves out of a person's body, often appear as lines of color painted onto the world and may be disoriented upon their birth. They gain intelligence and power by consuming human [[madra]], though they can be restricted by script circles or have their strength devoured by the [[Jai spear]]. While a master may leave behind a Remnant of powerful [[madra]], these tricky parts of [[sacred beasts]] can also be held in a core at the [[Gold stage]]. In some instances, such as with [[Yerin]], a Remnant may flicker with [[blood madra]] while wrapped around a person's waist like a belt.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Composed of solid [[madra]] that resembles a collection of brush-strokes, [[Remnants]] are entities representing a stage of progression higher than an [[Iron]]. These creatures can be dissected with specialized tools or swatted away like flies by those with sufficient power, and they possess [[madra]] that can be eaten by [[dreadbeasts]]. While some [[Remnants]] appear as tall, sunken beings with fish-like faces, others manifest as constellations of bright light points forming joints, eyes, and a heart. A Remnant's roar can sound like a bonfire, and they may leave behind specific techniques or powers for a successor. When contained within a core through strong suction, they can be broken down to provide excess energy or used to cleanse and restore [[madra]]. Notable examples include a Remnant with [[sapphire]] eyes in [[Lindon]]'s pack, one blending with [[Jai Long]]'s [[madra]], and a Remnant held in a death-grip by [[Yerin]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Appearing as a mute, nightmare-like [[skeleton]] within [[Yerin]]'s classroom, this Remnant serves as a leash for her. As echoes of individuals from their former lives, these beings consume pieces of themselves to function. Following the death of [[Malice]], a dim purple light signaled the Remnant's ascent, during which it beamed at [[Mercy]] to encourage her perseverance. While this entity once existed as a lion, it has since taken on a human appearance and possesses the capability to be integrated into a person's body.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Remnant]] is a being that once was a lion but now looks like a man.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“Good,” Kral said, and the tiny Remnant on his arm bit down.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“You're an Iron, not a Remnant; you still need sleep. Food.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“Her madra cleanses and restores, I think. She helped me too.”<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Remnant beamed. “Don’t give up, Mercy! We’ll do this together!”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" />}}
